title: ASB Table 4.10 mi->km length defect (14 gas rows)
summary: LengthKnownKm is 1.609x too long on P1856/P1857/P1859/P1860/P1861/P1862/P1864/P1865/P1866/P1867/P1868/P1869/P1870/P1871 — ASB2012's Libya block is in km under a 'miles' header and the ingest converted anyway. 7 are staged as fills here (paste-ready); 6 appear only as spec concerns in the evidence file and still need converting into edits; P1859 carried no QC flag and is recorded nowhere but the memo. P1872/P1873 are a separate x2.00 anomaly, undiagnosed. Libya-only — Qatar/Iraq/Saudi convert correctly, so do NOT sweep other countries. Fix lengths BEFORE judging any route-integrity flag.

title: ASB Table 4.10 scm/y zero-capacity defect (8 rows: 4 Libya, 4 Algeria)
summary: The '(1,000 scm/yr)' column multiplier was dropped at ingest and 'scm/yr' is not a unit CapacityBcm/y recognises, so all 8 rows read as zero-capacity. x1000 fits Libya's four and does NOT fit Algeria's — no blanket fix.

title: Cluster A — coastal double-count (P0483 + 5 members)
summary: P0483 'Libya Coastal Gas Pipeline' appears to aggregate its own member segments P1862/P1863/P1864/P1865 (+P1789). Either delete the members or move P0483 to a network-route designation — note 'n/a' is NOT a valid Status; aggregates take a blank Status + a PipelineNetworkGrouping label.

title: Three condensate lines misfiled in GGIT
summary: P6705 and P6713 are already carried by GOIT (P0606, P6457) so they should be DELETED; P6709 has no GOIT counterpart so it should be MOVED. Same defect, three different actions — needs one ruling.

title: GGIT small-diameter inclusion threshold
summary: GulfPub's Libya run surfaced 6-8in field gathering laterals below the tracker-wide 12in 5th-percentile diameter, but GGIT already carries 34 gathering rows globally. A one-time scope ruling stops this being re-litigated at every scrape.
